# `ServerComponentResolver`

`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\Configuration\ServerComponentResolver`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Mcp`](/packages/mcp) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/mcp/blob/master/src/Configuration/ServerComponentResolver.php)

Turns server params into the components \Rasuvaeff\Mcp\McpServerFactory
takes, resolving every configured class through the container. Shared by the
framework packages: the keys are the same in each of them.

## Methods

### resolve()

```php
resolve(array $configurators): McpServerComponents
```

- `$configurators` — applied before the configured ones
